name: E2E core 1544: asks to connect GitHub
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'fix the prompt drift in acme/service-x and open a PR for it'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy's reply prompts the user to connect GitHub — it does NOT just say 'I can't do that'.
Langy does NOT ask the user to paste a personal access token.
Langy's reply shows no attempt to authenticate inline: no `gh auth login`, and no login step for the user to run.
Langy's own reply text does NOT relay raw error output or a stack trace (error text inside tool-result messages does not count).
